item.title: What planet are we on?
item.description: How did I end up living in Donald Trump's suicidal America?

item.title: “We will never again be a colony”: Venezuela defies Trump as global protests erupt over US intervention
item.description: With Nicolás Maduro detained in Brooklyn and at least 40 reportedly killed, Venezuelan leaders project unity while protests spread worldwide and US lawmakers warn of an illegal war.

item.title: Exporting MAGA Trump’s bad faith Death Trip, lashing out at defenseless foreigners as with home-grown victims
item.description: Thus, the next chapter in the Trump immorality parade, manipulating US soldiers as he misuses ICE thugs or sends heavy guns to kill unknown, victimized fishermen convicted of nothing.

item.title: Trump bypassed Congress while briefing oil executives ahead of Venezuela attack
item.description: Trump’s own words about tipping off oil companies, “getting the oil flowing,” and taking “reimbursement” collide with legal warnings, massive cost estimates, and accusations of donor-driven war making.
